data.name: Amelia
data.gender_notes: Amelia is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic amal, 'work, labour', or a blend with Emilia. Its root is Germanic amal. A Christian name used across Europe. Amelia is a Germanic name meaning “Work; industrious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amelia expresses “Work; industrious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Germanic amal, 'work, labour', or a blend with Emilia.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amelia total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
